I didn't forget you, Dime_x.[/spoiler]

EVOOOOOOOOOOOOoooooooooooooooooooooooo....

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes - 7/6
notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
- Fix the last remaining type of unblockable setup, [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=68r4N_OUOh4]throw-then-hit[/url].  Long story short, if a throw whiffs through your jump-start animation the rest of that animation will be invincible to hits as well as throws.  Also if that happens unblockable-on-the-way-up grabs (Excellabella, A-Train) will be blockable for up to 8f.  Thanks Age.  [h1]PLEASE FIND PROBLEMS WITH THIS IF THERE ARE ANY, and report them in the bugs forum on Skullheart.  It seems slightly too clean for how effective it is and how little else it changes.[/h1]
- Parasoul's j.B+LK and j.LK are now really the same to the IPS.  Whoooooops, typos.  Thanks gllt.
- Extend Painwheel's cr.LK hitbox downward to always OTG without affecting range.
- Painwheel's Lv3 drags them in and ALWAYS does all the hits if it connects with the first one, even if it OTGs or hits them in an odd spot.  If you can find a consistent case where it spits them out the wrong way now, please tell me and I can fix that too.
- Fix Fukua's [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4FPkVR7t9Mc]auto-divekick[/url] that would randomly happen.  Thanks Natezer for getting me a repro case!
- Fix bugs with Fukua's BFFs super:  Shadow no longer hits after Fukua is DHC'd out; shadow doesn't go up with her as she leaps offscreen if DHC'd out; 2nd hit will not connect unless the opponent is in hitstun, so resetting them between hits is useless; if 2nd hit does not connect, Fukua immediately stops being invincible and can't be DHC'd out.  These fixes WILL be at Evo, so if you were abusing this junk I suggest you stop.  :^)
- Fix bug with Ground Tech option, providing an input for teching should require that the dummy is in hitstun.  :^P Thanks MyLifeIsAnRPG.
- Speed up menu loading by caching options text files and localization files in memory, this will likely only help consoles since PCs already do that.  But it does help consoles.  :^)
- Fix some framerate issues with things like Valentine's Lv3, by not rendering the level when the entire screen is covered by another sprite anyway.  How was I not doing this before?  Helps consoles tremendously.
- Fix character-art-file loading while on 360 switching characters again, as well as improve menu opening/loading speed.  Yeah, this isn't PC related, but it's nice.  Provided a new 360 patch to test, just the executable (so menu loading, hiccup when switching chars, framerate fix, that's all cuz no data).  Yay?


Today's the day you want to check out the Beta, though.  Really.

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes - April 1st, 2014
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.  It's April first.

Let's get this outta the way - the Beta changes are now in the real game.  Moving on...

To get right to the point, there has been a nasty rumor swirling around that a certain character would be added to the Real Game today.  A rumor which we have vehemently denied - and you know what [i]that[/i] means!

[h1]Have you been waiting 3 months for a character with a very unique j.HK, super armor, multiple command grabs, and a crazy level 5 super?   

Well...HERE SHE IS!

Skullgirls fans, say hello to [b]Fukua![/b][/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IXN5yr4dGIc

One of Brain Drain's less-socially-acceptable hobbies is cloning*, and often he forces the souls of dead warriors to inhabit these clones.
Fukua is the result of a fortunate - or unfortunate - Lab Zero accident: a union of two souls.  One, a once-proud warrior known for her brute strength in close combat; the other a silent assassin who specialized in ranged weapons for her kills.
Together as one, Fukua possesses the best of both specialties...but relationships formed under intense circumstances often don't last.

* "Movies?  When, Saturday?  Nah, can't.  Yeah, I'm busy.  Cloning.  YES, really!  Sorry, maybe next week."

[i]Now, we here at Lab Zero certainly believe in taking a joke to the FURTHEST extreme (and often well past that), so rather than simply making a moderately amusing video like those other [strike]lame companies[/strike] game companies...why not boot up dat Skullgirls?  :^)[/i]

[b]--------------[/b]
[b]Move list:[/b]
[b]--------------[/b]

Butterfly Kiss - HK in the air
-> Heartseeker - HP after Bufferfly Kiss connects

Love Dart - D,DF,F+P / 236+P, on the ground or in the air

Platonic Drillationship - D,DF,F+K / 236+K

Tender Embrace - D,DF,F+LP+LK / 236+LP+LK

Inevitable Snuggle - D,DB,B+LP+LK / 214+LP+LK

Blown Kiss [i](Lv 1 super)[/i] - D,DF,F+PP / 236+PP, on the ground or in the air

Best Friends Forever! [i](Lv 1 super)[/i] - D,DF,F+KK / 236+KK

Twice Shy [i](Lv 3 super)[/i] - D,DB,B+PP / 214+PP

Head Over Heels [i](Lv 5 super)[/i] - 360+LP+LK
Note:  It doesn't do much damage, but....

[i]Fukua is an avid fighting game player.  See if you can figure out which characters and moves she likes the most![/i]

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes 3-3
notes.notes:
Welcome to Monday.  More art format changes, another large update.

[b]General[/b]
[h1]- If a combo becomes burstable and you burst more than 90f after the first burstable hit, your burst will not be punishable (as if you bursted a projectile).[/h1]Burst baits that take under 90f still work as normal.  Fixes [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qSkMLEGgHuQ]this[/url], among other things.
- Assist hits that cause Sliding are now ground-techable in the Real Game.
- Cerebella color #20!  I bet nobody gets this, but I like it a LOT.
- Fixed an uncommon [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xLeU5Be_BM8]superflash + tag glitch[/url].

[b]Gameplay Bug Fixes[/b]
- When snapped in, Fortune cannot move her head until she is able to attack, like other characters.
- When tagged in, Fortune cannot move her head until 15f after the tag begins; she CAN still move it before she enters the screen, but it won't happen accidentally with the pressing of the tag buttons.  You have to specifically do something after you input the tag.
- Fortune's head is now projectile invincible when her body is being hit if it is not also being hit, will no longer absorb Motor Brigade or kart bomb during combos.
- Fenrir Drive no longer does the dive part if it did not hit the point character.

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes 2-23
notes.notes:
[h1]This update is large because the art file format was changed again - the next step to being able to fit Big Band on PS3.[/h1]

[b]General[/b]
- [b]Add LP+HK as an Assist 2 command[/b] to go along with LK+HP being Assist 1.  Really there was no reason not to, and someone reminded me about it.
- Fix air blocking bug that meant chicken-blocking close to the ground had recovery after landing for some characters!  Whoops.  Everyone recovers immediately upon landing now regardless of height.
- It is now easier and more consistent to combo off Cerebella's airthrow; fixed it to also not leave Big Band behind her.
- Fix cleanup error in Parasoul's sliding animation.
- Music volume changes from supers etc. now happens gradually instead of instantly.  If this by some chance causes crazy problems with the music during rollbacks online, please tell me.  I tested it pretty thoroughly but you never know...

If you ain't playin' the Beta, you're missin' all the fun(eta)!

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes 2-17
notes.notes:
Happy Last Hope Day!
I can FINALLY make Steam builds again, so here we go...

[b]General[/b]
[h1]- Hopefully fix the new controller menu issues.[/h1] WaLuigiTime, see if this random code mucking-with helps for you...maybe?

- Fix two obscure blocking-death bugs:  [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gGEWHFgYHsk]This[/url] from long ago, and [url=http://www.twitch.tv/keninblack/c/3707603?t=33s]this[/url] from recently.  You can no longer alpha counter after your character is dead.

notes.notes:
[b]General[/b]
[h1]- Fix longstanding lobby bug!  Lobbies should now be joinable by rightclicking a person in your Friends List and choosing "Join Game", and you can now invite people by going to your Friends List, rightclicking someone, and choosing "Invite To Game".[/h1]  Not sure what kind of problems this will cause, so if you notice for example that people who aren't your friends can search for and join your fully private lobby, please post in the comments. :^)

- Fix many more bugs with -useclipboard and -useclipboardsound.  No more repeating world name online, a missing dialog type now copies text, and tutorial objective text is now copied.

notes.title: The Typing of the Skullgirls patch notes 12-23
notes.notes:
I was working on the PS3 submission build, which meant I COULD NOT do anything to Big Band all week since I needed him not in the build.  To keep my sanity amid the closure of Cyberfront and everything else that happened this week, I made something*.  Without further ado, I bring you....

[h1][b]The Typing of the Skullgirls[/b][/h1]
[b]What?  Yes, [i]of course[/i] I'm serious.[/b]
- Code is [i]gottatypefast![/i]  (including the !) during the startup logos.
- Applies to Arcade, Story, Local Versus, and Marie 300%.  Does not apply online, in Tournament Mode, or in any Training mode.
- Play with a controller and type with the keyboard.
- Non-super hits do 33% dmg, super hits depend on your typing skeelz!  Failing the word does 10% dmg, finishing it does normal dmg, and finishing it with no errors does 150%.  (For AI supers, this is backward - failing the word you take 150% dmg, etc.)  Meter automatically builds outside combos, and there is a much higher minimum damage scaling on supers.
- You [u]can[/u] play with a keyboard and also type with the keyboard...but you need to unplug all controllers for this!   If you have a controller plugged in, even if it is not in use for a character, keyboard controls are DISABLED during fights to prevent weird interactions with the typist.  (This is only for Typing mode, everything still works normally in the normal game.)
- Currently only one keyboard is supported on PC.  [spoiler]But two are supported on the PS3 for true player+typist 2v2 team play.  It's not even funny how EASY it is to differentiate multiple keyboards on PS3 compared to Windows. Console master race, suckas![/spoiler]

[b]General[/b]
- Fix training dummy [url=http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qRhKGtyWfBM]not blocking after ground tech[/url] even when set to Block Always.
- Removed -psdriverhack, added [b]-vjoyfix[/b].  Default behavior is back to "normal" so that the majority of people don't have to do anything special.  [h1][b]tl;dr If you have problems with Up being pressed, use -vjoyfix to fix it![/b][/h1]  (Honestly, I'm not sure why I didn't just do it this way in the first place.)
- Add CPU option in training mode!  Choose your difficulty and off you go.  Note:  All other settings still apply on P2 even with AI enabled, meaning you can record reversals and fight the AI with them doing specific reversals, set it to always throw tech, always ground tech, etc.
- Add menu sounds on generic options menus.  I had been waiting to do this FOREVER.  This is for you, you-know-who-you-are.

*special thanks to Brady, you're great!

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes 12-16
notes.notes:
[edit] Made a small update that fixes states not being properly tagged, most of which were in Filia because she was the first character we made.  LP Updo is now shown as -58 instead of +1.

[b]General[/b]
[h1]- FIXED the always-holding-Up controller bug.  If you are using a T.E. stick, you will now have to set it to Left Stick (instead of D-Pad), and Eightarc owners will have to hit Mode.[/h1]  Long story short, we were reading the POV hats even if your device reported that it didn't have any, because the T.E. drivers report no hats then proceed to use a hat anyway.  Now we no longer do that, which means T.E.s are back to requiring the Left Stick setting, but it won't be broken for non-T.E.s or vjoy!  Yay!
[h1]- Add automated frame data display in training mode![/h1]  Displays startup and block/hit advantage.  [b]Change Attack Data to Advanced, and it will display at the bottom when you do moves.[/b]  This HAS to have some huge problem I didn't catch, but all the examples I checked are correct: whiffed move duration, advantage on hit/block, and reversal punishes.  (O.o)
Doesn't show startup for projectiles because that's way too complicated.
[i]Frame data is NOT Capcom style, startup frames are [u]never[/u] active: 5f startup = hits on the [b]6th[/b] frame. A 5f-startup move can't punish a -5 move, but it can punish a -6 move.[/i]
- Clear input list when loading a savestate in training mode.
- Remove shadows from Parasoul's flame effects that still had them, oops.
- Improve HOT FIYA effects a bit by randomly varying the size of the flames.

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes 12-10
notes.notes:
[h1]I missed one experimental Beta change because I typo'd in script*, which is now being tested in the Beta.[/h1]
If you play Peacock, head over and try it out so you can voice your opinion.
[b]This is the ONLY change that's still on the table.[/b]

[b]General[/b]
- Add training mode features!  We finally got text for these, so here they are:
[i]Stagger Recovery[/i] - turn this on to enable the Dummy to shake out of any stagger as fast as possible.  Pummel Horse to Showstopper is NOT A COMBO, people.
[i]Force Counterhit[/i] - turn this on to make every hit or throw a counterhit, so you can practice counterhit combos.
[i]Skip Superflashes[/i] - aka "Darkstalkers mode" - turn this on to cause the game to skip any frames that occur during a superflash.  For those of you wondering why there is hitstop after superflashes, try this and you'll see what it's for.  With hitstop, a 5f-startup super is a 5f attack and the hitstop is simply aesthetic. WITHOUT hitstop, a 5f-startup super with a superflash is a 65f attack!  (This option only affects training mode, sorry, but you can set health to Normal and deaths allowed to Yes.  And yes, it'll skip things like Seria Sing or Road Roller.)

For the person who asked for "Random Reversal" for dummy recordings, that's been there for a while!  Set it to "As Reversal" and for Slot pick "Random".  :^)

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Fix Filia j.HK hitbox to make it more consistent in situations where it should hit.
- Improve Filia's Ringlet Psych visually, add sound effects, and shorten it by 9f to make it somewhat more useful.
- Fix the small shimmy at the end of Fortune's Lv3 before the explosion that could very rarely cause a crossup if she missed and you were standing right on top of her head.


* This happens more than I would like to admit.  (^.^)'

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes 12-9
notes.notes:
[h1]This is Olive:[/h1]
[img=http://i.imgur.com/ENRWghPl.jpg][/img]
She's [url=http://imgur.com/ENRWghP]pretty adorable[/url], and I assure you she's just as soft as she looks.  [spoiler]She and her relatives are running around in Maplecrest, along with a lot of other Lab Zero pets![/spoiler]

[i]"But under what auspices does she grace these-here patch notes?"[/i] you might ask.
Well!  She is here to announce that...
[h1]Olive the Beta features are now in the Real Game![/h1]

This includes Undizzy changes, some character fixes, and Downs instead of rounds, but it does not include Big Band because he's not done yet.

[b]Summary[/b]
- Undizzy ([url=http://pastebin.com/JpRe9Ggt]what's that?[/url]) is now 240, and accumulates any time after Stage 2.  It can go above the maximum and will take longer to go back to zero the higher it is, obviously.  Your combos are now much shorter.
- You can always combo up to Stage 5 without triggering an Undizzy burst even if you are already at 240 Undizzy.
- Counterhits subtract Undizzy, 25/50/100 for L/M/H hits.  Counterhit specials and throws subtract 50, assists subtract 25, and supers subtract 0.  Undizzy CAN go below zero, so if you land a counterhit Hard Punch or Hard Kick you can still do some pretty impressive stuff.
- Downs instead of Rounds for 1v1, like I said.  You'll see.
- Meter gain for the victim was lowered at the start of a combo, but continues to go up over the course of the combo just like before.
- Assist hits that start combos scale the combo to 66% (1000 dmg -> 667); if the assist is a counterhit it scales the combo to 90% (1000 dmg -> 900).

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes - 10-19
notes.notes:
[h1]There's a 3v3 Skullgirls today, Saturday 10-19, at Super Arcade in Walnut, CA, at 4PM.  Graciously held by IE Battlegrounds, it will be [url=http://twitch.tv/iebattlegrounds]streamed on their Twitch channel.[/url]  Come play or tune in and watch as I try to get those ornery 'top' players interested in SG again!  (Also there are some other games too, I guess. :^)[/h1]

This update's got a bunch of gameplay fixes.

[b]General[/b]
- COMPLETE update for Portuguese - if you're Brazilian, check it out and let us know that it isn't such a garbled mess anymore.  (Check it out even if you've just [i]gotten[/i] a Brazilian...)
- Fixed up some errors in French, Spanish, and German too.
- Add more IGG backer colors for...I can't remember, look for yourself!  Double's is her sole IGG color request, so we went "all the way" for it.  <3
- "Death Allowed:  No" in Training Mode now really means it.  Moves that would previously kill you with this option set should no longer do that.
- Add back the VO for Filia's snapback.  WTH.
- Update Contributor Credits.  Those who were complaining about not being included are now included.  Except for Mr. B===D, I guess you're just not cool enough or something.

[b]Lobbies[/b]
- Better sorting in QotH for guests.
- Confirmation window when exiting lobbies.
- Spectators no longer get achievements.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Double can no longer control cat heads while stuck by Val’s counter.
- Squigly's Lv1 DP invincibility now correctly overlaps the first 2 active frames. Whoops.
- Air super update:  Air EKG / Air Gregor / Buer Thresher / Feral Edge only cause post-superflash hitstop for 1f of the active frames.  In real terms, they aren't guaranteed as far away now.  Buer Thresher has been altered so that there is an instant hitbox right next to Painwheel, but the farther spikes are able to be blocked post-flash.  If you didn't understand any of this, don't worry about it.  [i]tl;dr Less to whine about with mashing certain supers now.[/i]
- Increase vertical size of first hit of Fortune’s MK/HK Fiber Upper.  (This is actually a fix, she already had the extra boxes but they were of physical-extent type rather than attack type.)
- Characters that are DHC'd out no longer count as having-been-hit-as-assist, and thus do not lock themselves out for any period of time.  Alpha counter -> super -> DHC back to original character is now possible, a-la MvC2.
- Fix Drama problems: 
-- Drama now will never clear on regular wakeup.
-- Your own Drama now clears on DHC, tag, and alpha counter (as well as the previous things, ground tech and burst).  Tagging or DHCing out at high Drama now will get you fully punished.

[i]Dis game gon git ta Evo soonr r lata![/i]

notes.title: 10-4 good buddy, Skullgirls patch notes a-comin' yer way!
notes.notes:
In a statement released earlier, Skullgirls spokesman Mike Z (Z-CA) said:
[i]There will be no further jokes today, the [b]Skullgirls Patch Note Joke Department[/b] is part of a non-essential branch of the U.S. government and has been shuttered for the duration of the current situation.  We regret any inconvenience this may cause.[/i]

[b]Lobbies[/b]
- Queen of the Hill improvements:
-- Everyone will all cycle correctly now.
-- Proper display of streak when you join a lobby.
-- If the Queen is unready for 20 seconds, she loses her crown. That way they can't hold up the entire room.
- All-play:  If the match is a draw, it goes back to the lobby now. No more auto-rematch

[b]General[/b]
- Add [b]animated Indiegogo backer NPCs[/b] to Casino!  5 different NPC layouts that rotate, also present in the 2D versions!  The layout will not chnage on Play Again if you just chose Casino, but it will change if you re-pick the stage and it changes each time the Casino comes up from Random.  Layouts are not [i]quite[/i] final...
- Started adding [b]Indiegogo backer colors[/b]!  Color 19 for Valentine, MsFortune, and Squigly is now available.  (edit:  Backer colors are all FREE, you don't have to buy anything new.)
- AI now will burst from max-Drama sparks.  Thank you person who pointed this out in the last patch note comments.  (Remember I called it Drama?  Heh.)
- Fix crash when choosing Restore Defaults from button config in a single-player match.  Oops.

[b]Cerebella[/b]
- If Run was input during hitstop, can now hold the button for a followup attack and it will come out.  Er, in normal-speak: s.HP xx Run->Kanchou is now much easier, just hold the button for the Kanchou.

notes.title: Skullgirls MIGHTY NUMBER Patch Notes - 10/1
notes.notes:
MIGHTY NUMBER NINE MIGHTY NUMBER NINE MIGHTY NUMBER...patch notes, right, patch notes.  

Been a while, hasn't it?  There's some stuff here you'll like.  C'mon in, grab yourself a snack and have at these wonderful updates while you dream about mighty numbers of some kind.

[b]Lobbies[/b]
- [b]Spectator mode[/b] is now in! If you don't get assigned a partner, you're randomly assigned a match to spectate! 
- Added [b]Queen of the Hill[/b] mode for lobbies! (Report all bugs for Queen of the Hill Mode and Spectating issues to bugreport AT labzerogames dot com.)
-- Queen of the Hill mode is what you'd expect:
** The winner stays, loser goes to the end of the line.
** You can't ready up if there's a match going on. This may be enabled soon.
** 15 seconds between matches, instead of 10.
** You automatically re-ready after matches. (Do you like this? Let us know!)
** Win streak is tracked, instead of total wins.
** Your place in line is determined by when you ready up. If you unready for more than 5 seconds, you lose your place in line.
- Fixed some avatar issues.  If you rejoin, there still will be issues, but another patch will come soon to fix that.

[b]General[/b]
- Fixed USB headset crash. If your game was crashing before and now it works, it's because you were outputting mono.
- Fixed some localization crashes and blank texts in Spanish.
- Fixed some UI navigation and gfx issues.
- Add Marie 300% to Extras.  Feel free to frustrate yourself to no end again!  You have to own Squigly, though.  :^)
- Add NPCs in 2D backgrounds for Medici Office, New Meridian, Lab 8, Cathedral, Innsmouth.  The background is still one single picture, so if you have a slow computer they don't have any negative effects.  If you experience negative effects, they are probably psychosomatic.
- Improve contrast between characters and background on Cathedral, New Meridian, Innsmouth.
- Fix CRAZY bugs in Otter that give a wonderful speedup on console AND PC.  Most computers won’t notice, but if yours is bad you might?
- Increase GGPO max rollback frames by 4, to 24.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- Fix Fortune’s s.HK hitboxes!  WHOOPS.
- Fix occasional IPS carryover on 1f links for Player 2.
- Fix Diamonds are Forever glitch.  http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6dD1rdiZnlA 

[i]We should have assigned ASG#s to everyone, I wonder what Painwheel and Peacock would be...how many came before...[/i]

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes - 9/13 oh noes...
notes.notes:
We will begin testing Spectating and Queen of the Hill mode (^.^) in the Beta in the next day or two.

If you expect humor, today is not the day for humor.  Console bugs are all-encompassing and soul sucking.  [i]Did you know there was a console bug that drowned here, two years before those kids went missing?  Shoulda been watched, every minute...[/i]

[b]Lobbies[/b]
- Can back out of Lobby Creation with MK.
- Lobbies now back out to Lobby Search instead of Main Menu.
- Better lobby searches.  You might find more games!
- Smarter distribution of All Play matches - you play people you've played the least.
- Fixed some localization issues - blank regions for some people, blank Win counts for Spanish.
- Ping text is now colored according to the ping value.  [i]Please let us know if you notice anything...strange...[/i]
- Game type is now displayed in upper corner of lobby instead of Region type.

[b]General[/b]
- NEW GGPO!  Hopefully desyncs are all gone; returned to console-sized rollback buffer (you don't need to know what that really means, but it generally means better performance!)
- "Fix" PC attract movie, the hackiest way possible.  [spoiler][i]With a machete![/i][/spoiler]
- Removed progress notification for World Warrior Princess, since it has to be completed in one Random session.
- Added something you should [i]never see[/i]. Hopefully.
- Disabled setting the corner of the Steam overlay notification.
- Add "Marie 300%" to the Extras menu.  [i]She's back, and she's pissed![/i]

[b]Levels[/b]
- New camera shake response on Maplecrest.
- Add NPCs in 2D backgrounds for Medici Office, New Meridian, Lab 8, Cathedral, Innsmouth.  
- Improve contrast between characters and background on Cathedral, New Meridian, Innsmouth.  Should make the characters easier to see - if you're colorblind and it is worse, please say something in the comments.

notes.notes:
We will begin testing Spectating and Queen of the Hill mode (^.^) in the Beta in the next day or two.

If you expect humor, today is not the day for humor.  Console bugs are all-encompassing and soul sucking.  [i]Did you know there was a console bug that drowned here, two years before those kids went missing?  Shoulda been watched, every minute...[/i]

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes (9-2, goodness it's September already?!)
notes.notes:
UPDATE'S UPDATE: We have made a new build which fixes Quick Match also being set to training mode.  Enjoy!

An update on Labor Day?  What's a national holiday to the Skullgirls team...we never stop...  ;_;

We think we know what causes the online desyncs, but we need some more info - check the "Other" section.

[b]Lobbies[/b]
- Add online training mode!  Choose "Training" instead of "All Play" for Lobby Type.  [b]If you want to SEARCH for Training lobbies, set your Search Type to "Training" down there at the bottom of the screen.[/b]
2-person room only, gives infinite life/time/meter, can't earn achievements.  To quit, press P+K+Start. (A reminder for how to quit is displayed.)

[b]General[/b]
- Stage-select button shortcuts!  Shown below each stage.  Like choosing a specific color, just hit that button combo to go right to that stage without scrolling.  All shortcuts are 2+ buttons, so pressing any single button will choose the current choice.

[b]Other[/b]
- Add "-ggpodebug" command-line option.  If you are getting desyncs, use this! You will see red screen flashes during gameplay.  The flashes can happen WITHOUT desyncs if there was no input from the opponent on that frame, that's okay.  But I really want to know if a DESYNC happens WITHOUT a red flash!
- Add ‘-nomenuwrap’ command-line option.  Does what it says, if you don't know why we added it then I promise you don't want to use it.  (^.^)

A note is fine, too.

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes (8-31)
notes.notes:
We're going back to not-bulleted-list format, the front page display screws up lists (hah) and I have to buy more ammo anyway.

Spectator mode is still in-progress, it no longer crashes but is not quiiiiiiiite good enough for Beta testing.

[b]Lobbies[/b]
- More lobby crash fixes, specifically around leaving during the countdown RIGHT when you get your partner assigned.
- "999MS" is now "?MS"...because it's unknown.  [i]I[/i] certainly don't know any question marks, do you?
- You can now back out of the Ping Confirm window with MK in Quick Match again.

[b]General[/b]
- Stage preview on stage select!  Yay!  (Those buttons at the bottom of the screen are for shortcuts, but they don't work yet.)
- World Warrior Princess and My Pain Will Be Visited Upon You now show achievement progress. Nothing changed, or was even broken, in terms of earning them.

[b]Squigly[/b]
- Fix Daisy Pusher on late hits, the opponent should no longer just get tripped and not fall in, ever.

[b]Big Band[/b]
- Did more work on him, including adding his permissions to the DLC file that IGG backers have...but at this point mentioning it is just taunting you all.  :^)  Yes, the beta will still be used for testing things, including this saxy beast when he is ready.

You know what I highly recommend?

SLEEP.

Sleep...and Azumanga Daioh.  There's nothing a good dose of Takino Tomo won't fix.  (I tried Nichijou, but it just came across as trying too hard to achieve what Azumanga did without really understanding how Azumanga did it.  Cue nerd rage.)

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes (8-27)
notes.notes:
It's been a busy few days!
In addition to sleeping, eating, staring listlessly out the window, and eating [url=http://shop.stevesicecream.com/products/mexican-chili-chocolate]Steve's Mexican Chili Chocolate ice cream[/url], which is as close as I have ever found to [url=http://sebastianjoesicecream.com/ice-cream]Sebastian Joe's Chocolate Coyote[/url] outside Minneapolis!  I HIGHLY recommend you check out Sebastian Joe's if you live near the Twin Cities, or Steve's if you can find it near you.  Mexican chocolate ice cream with cayenne pepper is a fantastic experience...in addition to that, we've...er...where was I?

Oh right, patch notes.

[b]Lobbies[/b]
[list]
[*] If no lobbies are found, it will automatically re-search every 5 seconds.
[*] Fixed some lobby crashes/hangs. (Gotta catch 'em all!)
[*] Fixed some broken/stuck animations.
[*] Disabled the empty YES/NO menu for non-hosts.
[*] Fixed some countdown issues, but it's never enough for you.  It's NEVER ENOUGH!  :: sob ::
[*] Restored VS Icons (...oops!)
[/list]
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed "Medical Board Will be Notified" achievement.  You have to do 40 from NOW, though.
[*] Added Portuguese translations for achievements.  (I would normally have said something in my terrible Portuguese here but I figure it's less offensive just to say "Yay!")
[*] Enabled online connection indicator "bars" at the beginning of online rounds.  Remember, this is NOT the same as ping.  Don't like 'em?  They're better than the borders were.  :^)
[*] Aimed, armed, and bought dinner for the VAC banhammer. (Do you REALLY want to try playing as her now?)
[*] Fixed strange whiff sparks in Peacock s.HK if you cancel it, and fixed her feet in MP Bang! recovery.
[*] Fixed font on PS3, needed to be done if we want to make those console versions.
[*] Still slogging through implementing spectator mode and online training mode.  Not QUITE ready for prime time, but will be in the beta soonish.
[/list]
I [i]love[/i] me some ice cream.

notes.title: Skullgirls Patch Notes (8/23)
notes.notes:
Welcome to [strike]zombo.com[/strike] the PC release of Skullgirls!
Make yourself at home...have some notes, maybe an apple slice...

** Gameplay changes are pretty much done now, the rest of the updates will be missing features or fixes. **

[b]Beta -> Release[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Squigly's story mode and the Rooftops Assault stage!  See, we [i]can[/i] keep a secret!
[*]Fortune:  Catching the opponent out of the air with Headbutt or Zoom adds 45 Drama* instead of the regular 30.  [i]Do you still love me, Inuchiyo?[/i]
[*]Painwheel:  Gains 1/3 of the normal amount of meter for attacks while Installed.
[*]Squigly:
[list]
[*]Daisy Pusher is now active and invincible for 23 frames.  Still jump-able after the superflash but is now a much better answer to lots of things.  (In FGC-speak, Daisy Pusher is 4+9, active for 23.)  "SLYAM DYANCE!"
[*]All specials properly do chip damage.
[*]Special-to-super-cancel windows adjusted to match everyone else.  Cannot cancel in the recovery of things, no more cancelling in the middle of Silver Chord, etc.
[*]Damage adjustment:  j.HK 1412, j.HP 1406, j.MP 550, j.MK 1362, s.MP 850, s.HP 750+800.  (Some numbers may seem odd because multi-hit moves are affected by damage scaling.)
[*]Lots of art fixes.
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Release 8/22 -> 8/23[/b]
[list]
[*]Enable Valentine's color #9.  Whoops.
[*]Locked Squigly's tutorial if you don't have her DLC.  Whoops.
[*]Fix lots of text and translation issues.
[*]Brightened up Rooftops Assault.
[*]Even more Squigly art fixes.
[/list]

* someone suggested calling Undizzy Stun "Drama".  Whee.  Keep it?
